mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lung and body routes was most worthwhile because the final picture showed how blood returns to the heart after each trip.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two valve sets was clear but a little repetitive, since both were named slots.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the heart's own vessels to be required before adding blood. The explanation that blood in the chambers cannot feed all the thick heart muscle made their purpose clear.

arbitrary.text: The order requiring the heart's own vessels before blood felt a little arbitrary: their purpose was understandable, but I hadn't realized they were a prerequisite.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because connecting the pieces into two complete routes made me curious how circulation supports other body systems.
